predictions: A pretty decent 17-6 last week, and man, was I ever close to running a perfect week… My 6 incorrect picks included a 12-12 (where my pick had led 12-4), four 13-11s, and a 14-10. Just a handful of wire crossings and I go 23-0!! Dangit. That brings me to 209-97 (68.3% correct) for the season. Looks like I'm going to end with about half a dozen teams fooling me at least as often as they don't, with The Outlaws as my worst.

Match of the week: (B Div.) Raging Bulls @ The Outlaws. If the very talented Stumble Out can take out Hump Day, this match decides who finishes 2nd in B and likely gets the title of "A division team" next season. If Stumble doesn't win, this is still for 2nd for just The Outlaws (in a point race with the Humpers). How tight do I think this will be? Well, Raging has only played ONE match all season with a winning score (win or lose) higher than 15. I'll take The Outlaws, in the last 501.

Matches #2 & #3: (D Div.) Darty Sanchez @ Menace 2 Sobriety; Liquor Possee @ Irish Ton. The best race in the league sits right here (even if it decided primarily by a penalty so far). Sanchez and Possee are only 5 points apart, with the same record, and are both facing teams with winning records. The evil side of me wants them to both win or race for 2nd. Wing wins this, but this will be super dramatic. 13-11.

Matches #8 & #9: (A Div.) Talladega Flights @ Dart Attack; Darty Minds @ Show Me Your Tips. The 6th place A team might well find itself in B next season, but the gap between 6th and about 2nd in A is really narrower than you might expect, in terms of talent. I'm guessing both Dart Attack and Darty Minds will lose here, and it will then be a point race to avoid 6th place (Dart Attack owns the tiebreaker if they end with the same point total). A very good team will be in danger of falling out of A. Talladega, 16-8; Show Me, 15-9.
